Zombie1 will stop if:
- Zombie 2 is front of Zombie 1
- Forward Zombie1->Zombie 2 distance is greater than Forward Zombie2->Zombie2 distance
- Distance between Zombie1 and Zombie2 is lower than interval
- Target is in front
For chimio to ignore his own armchair, we set LOS obstacles to Custom and manually add buildings
if barnacle is ignore chair type they also ignore characters that are in chair
Ignore character if they're in a chair, we want the chair to be grabbed.
if tentacle has grabbed the character but the latter is in a chair, grab the chair instead (hack shit)
Barnacle target's position is set to the tentacles' tip
After barnacle has eaten or collided with target, it is not being grabbed anymore
